note: Other sensory structure of an audited paper: the ED cells of this paper are on main under eye_diameter_mm (desk-d613); grep of docs/ for Pseudopaludicola coracoralinae and DOI 10.5852/ejt.2020.679 finds only those eye_diameter_mm rows. Reached by the unfiltered WebSearch 'europeanjournaloftaxonomy.eu Pseudopaludicola coracoralinae Andrade Haga Lyra Carvalho Haddad Giaretta Toledo Goiás palm pdf' (EJT download link in own results). Text read from the EJT PDF through the WebFetch page reader. Author line as returned: 'Felipe Silva de ANDRADE, Isabelle Aquemi HAGA, Mariana Lúcio LYRA, Thiago Ribeiro de CARVALHO, Célio Fernando Baptista HADDAD, Ariovaldo Antonio GIARETTA & Luís Felipe TOLEDO'. Licence sentence on the PDF copy read: 'This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0).' Crossref not used. Species validity: Amphibian Species of the World page opened from own search results: heading 'Pseudopaludicola coracoralinae Andrade, Haga, Lyra, Carvalho, Haddad, Giaretta, and Toledo, 2020', Eur. J. Taxon. 679: 13, Holotype ZUEC 24704 by original designation, no synonymy or redelimitation. The ASW Comment gives its placement as sister of P. atragula + P. facureae and says it could only be reliably distinguished from P. canga and P. facureae by call or molecules; no split, synonymy or redelimitation; family Leptodactylidae, subfamily Leiuperinae. Audit-1304 (4 Nov 2026) re-read the EJT PDF from its own search result: heading path above 'Description of the holotype' as now given in where; neighbours of the quoted sentence 'Vocal slits present.' and 'Discrete tympanic ridge from behind eye to proximal portion of arm insertion.'; Methods eye-size passage 'Twelve morphometric traits were measured following Watters et al. (2016): snout–vent length, head length, head width, eye diameter, interorbital distance, eye–nostril distance,' [...] (no tympanum trait listed); no other tympanum sentence in the Diagnosis, comparisons or P. parnaiba account; holotype 'BRAZIL • adult ♂; [...] ZUEC 24704 (Figs 4, 5A).'; licence sentence whole as above; byline, title, '679: 1–36 (2020)' and DOI read on the first page.
